mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is currently 44 degrees, feels like 35, and remains overcast at Harriet Park. We have a Waxing Gibbous moon, and the ISS will be soaring overhead tonight starting at 5:01 PM, rising from the northwest near Verona High School and heading toward the northeast near Home Depot.

City Hall reminds residents that municipal buildings and the recycling center will be closed on November 26 and 27 for Thanksgiving, with Thursday refuse pickup delayed until Friday. Additionally, the city is working on plans for a new public works facility and continues road construction projects on Mark Drive and Legion Street.
There is plenty to do this week, starting with live music at Bailey's Run today and at Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow, followed by yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow as well.
On November 2, officers responded to the 100 block of West End Circle regarding a domestic disturbance, resulting in the arrest of a 48-year-old man for battery and disorderly conduct.
Treat yourself to today's flavor, OREO Cookie Overload, available while the store is open until 10 PM tonight.
